text:
deploy-bot: release v7.0 streaming rollout started: canary group A (5% traffic) now on sdk-stream-v7. flag: enable_v7_stream=true :rocket:
Maria G.: seeing increased 5xx from the canary w/ streaming clients. alerting oncall.
Jonah: logs show `stream_handshake_timeout` and `invalid_frame` errors from connection pool.
SRE Lead: can you paste a sample log + request headers?
Jonah: sure — snippet:```
[t=2026-03-15T01:04:12Z] conn=abcd1234 client=10.240.1.5 model=redwood-std stream_id=0x7f handshake_timeout
[t=2026-03-15T01:04:12Z] conn=abcd1234 error=rpc: invalid frame header: 0x0a
```
Ingrid L.: rolling canary results in protocol drift — v7 changed the streaming preface (we bumped wire version). older clients (v6) can't reconnect cleanly.
Ryan: any end-user reports yet? support-bot: 3 open tickets from ACME (Acme Payments) showing "stream disconnected mid-charge" and increased retry loops.
Acme Payments Ops: we're seeing timeouts on our end, payment flows failing intermittently starting ~01:03Z. This is high-sev for our customers.
Maria G.: escalation — probable client-incompatibility with v7 streaming frames. impact: canary (5% traffic) but includes a few high-volume customers (Acme). Decision point: kill flag or rollback.
SRE Lead: immediate mitigation plan: 1) flip enable_v7_stream=false for canary via FF service 2) if errors continue, start rollback of deployment group A 3) reroute Acme to v6 endpoint temporarily.
Jonah: flipping flag now. Command: `curl -XPOST https://flags.internal/enable_v7_stream/disable -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx"`
deploy-bot: feature flag disable acknowledged; propagation started to canary hosts (5 nodes). :gear:
Maria G.: monitoring metrics... errors dropped but some lingering disconnects in the next 2 minutes. Could be connection pooling/dangling frames.
Ingrid L.: we should also force-close active streaming connections on canary hosts to pick up new config. Can we do a graceful drain?
SRE Lead: initiating drain of canary pool with `drain-connections --group canary-a --grace 5s`
Jonah: drain issued, a few clients retried and landed on v6. Acme reported a partial recovery.
Acme Payments Ops: saw recovery on ~01:10Z, thank you. Will monitor for any residual failures.
Ryan: we should still roll back the canary deploy; the flag disable is a good quick fix but wire-version mismatch risk remains. Recommend rollback to previous deployment revision where v6 runtime is present.
Maria G.: agreed — patch release contains breaking change to streaming wire. Rolling back group A now. Calling oncall handoff: Ingrid you take lead for rollback, I'll coordinate customer comms and postmortem.
Ingrid L.: acknowledged. Starting rollback to revision r20260314-199. Command: `deployctl rollback --group canary-a --rev r20260314-199`
deploy-bot: rollback started for canary-a. Estimated completion ~02m.
Jonah: while rollback runs, capturing packet-level logs from a failed session for the postmortem. Paste saved to /var/tmp/2715009999-acme-pcap.log
SRE Lead: monitoring cluster: error rate back to baseline as hosts finish rollback. No broader region impact.
support-bot: opened support ticket INC-2715009 and linked to customer ACME contact.
Maria G.: communications: posting to status page: "Degraded streaming for a subset of customers due to an SDK wire-version mismatch during v7 canary rollout; mitigation in progress; some customers experienced intermittent failures (e.g., Acme Payments)."
Acme Payments Ops: appreciate the heads up. We'll keep an incident channel open.
Ingrid L.: rollback complete on canary-a. Confirming all canary hosts on r20260314-199 and v6 streaming runtime.
Jonah: running integration test sweep against canary-a: all streaming checks passing.
SRE Lead: closing mitigation: feature flag is off, canary rollback done, customer routes stabilized. No full prod rollback required. Next actions:
Maria G.: action items — (1) block v7 wire-version change behind explicit client opt-in and compatibility check (2) add pre-deploy integration tests that include older client binaries (v6) in canary matrix (3) schedule hotfix to restore v7 behind a compatibility shim or negotiate client bump window.
Ryan: I'll own the compatibility test and add it to CI. Jonah will own test artifacts and packet captures. Ingrid will write rollout/playbook updates for streaming wire changes. Maria will draft postmortem and customer notes.
SRE Lead: tagging incident severity: sev2 due to partial customer impact. Creating incident ticket: INC-2715009.
Maria G.: thanks all. leaving a short audit log and next-steps doc in the incident tracker. We'll reconvene for postmortem tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
